reviews.text: My family and I love Urban PetRx! The staff and vets, specifically Dr. June LaFave, were exceptionally kind, understanding, and accommodating to my dog and family's situations. So many other vet clinics in the city prioritize volume of pet patients over personalized care, but Urban PetRx stands out as a locally owned vet clinic that prioritizes your pet's health over EVERYTHING and will work with you to make sure you and your pet can access care no matter what.

Dr. LaFave and the Urban Pet team have been an invaluable part of our senior dog's care. We used to only bring her in once a year for her annual exam/bloodwork/vaccines, but this year has been different.

Disclaimer: I worked as a technician/nurse here several years ago but have been out of the veterinary profession for some time. Urban Pet was by far the best experience I had out of all the other clinics I had worked in - I would not go out of my way to post this if I didn't honestly believe it. The team and doctor(s) have great attention to detail and communication.

We unfortunately received a cancer diagnosis recently, but Dr. LaFave has been instrumental in helping us navigate our options during a difficult time. I cannot truly quantify the appreciation we feel for the kindness and compassion given.

This is the best animal hospital I’ve been to. Their prices are fair, the bedside many of all of their doctors, reception, and techs is always stellar. My cat had a large tumor and they helped me make the best decision for the well being of my baby and his quality of life. I’lol be bringing all of my animals here going forward!
Not at all welcoming to new clients - I do not recommend this practice. Find a conscientious veterinarian that truly cares for the well-being of your pet.
Nice staff. Good communication.

I’ve been taking my dog here for a couple of years now and I’ve always had great experiences with this office. The staff is patient, courteous, and professional. They take such good care of my dog during his procedures and checkups. Great communication with the doctor and front desk, and they’re always eager to answer questions.

My cat Socks and I have had great experiences with both Dr. LaFave and Dr. Morgan since we moved to the area. For example, last year Socks had a mysterious infection that seemed like a UTI but wouldn’t clear up. Dr. LaFave provided some alternate medication options that ultimately cleared up the infection without having to go the more intense/expensive options such as a biopsy (though she did provide all the options and let me choose). I appreciate their knowledge and forthrightness and am so glad they’re in the neighborhood.

Dr. June LeFave must be short for Le Favorité. Because that's how we see it, our favorite Veterinarian. We met with LeFave three days ago after our cat had life threatening health concerns. The treatment plan was not a cheap one but completely reasonable. In total, we spent about $300, and we will be switching to a healthier food and not the cheap garbage on the shelf at any grocery store.

Before we went to Urban, I did review the comments before making a decision whether to come here or try a cheaper or potentially free alternative. Coming here was definitely the right choice. It was actually a life defining moment of what type of pet family we are: is our cat a family member, or is the pet a thing we can get rid of because it doesn't fit our budget.

If you are like me and questioned the validity of the 1 star reviews, please consider that I found the critics unfounded. LeFave will NOT push unnecessary treatments, the prices are NOT too expensive, and for our personal human to human experience, the connection was real. Just a genuine human to human interaction between people who care for the animal above all else.

I'll conclude with acknowledging a night and day difference in Rockets' behavior, post visit! Happy cat 😺
We have taken both our cat and dog to Dr. LaFave and we trust her care immensely. The office staff is kind and helpful and her office beautifully appointed and spotless.

When we checked in no one mentioned that all the rooms were full so we would be delayed. We waiting 35 minutes until someone spoke with us. They tried to do our appointment in the waiting area because the rooms were full, which doesn’t work because that’s where other patients are. They should have mentioned the rooms being full when we checked in.

I used to love this place and have been bringing my one-year-old dog here since we got her, but this last visit completely changed my experience.

I came in open to discussing options after an injury she sustained over the weekend, but the exam felt extremely rushed—they spent only a brief moment with her before pushing for sedation without trying less invasive approaches or involving me.

At one point during what was supposed to be her exam, I asked for a moment to take a 1 minute call from work, and shortly after I overheard a vet tech making rude comments suggesting I didn’t care about my dog, using profanity and aggressive language in the office common area - completely unprofessional.

There was little effort to explain alternatives before escalating care, which was frustrating since I was willing to make informed decisions.

Overall, this was very disappointing and not at all the level of care I had experienced before.
You all took amazing care of my little Mija throughout the years. I am eternally grateful for everyone at Urban PetRx.

My mom had the worst experience in this place on yesterday. She called the day before and asked if they could administer an IV for her sick dog. They told her yeah it will be $20 for the service and $35 for the IV when she arrived, she met with Ashley, who from the beginning was very rude. Ashley asked her about her employment and she told her that she was Unemployed. The dog actually belongs to me and my mom was just bringing her in. My mom is an attorney and isn't working because she just moved to Chicago while they brought her a bill for $1200 after the Consultation and she went ahead and told her that she wasn't going to pay that that she was only there for an IV Ashley became upset And told my mom to take Her unemployed self back to the animal welfare league. This is the most unprofessional place ever it was just a money grab, and my mom was racially profiled. Ashley is the most unprofessional person ever who has a chip on her shoulder and do not have respect for her elders. I will never bring my dog back here as my mom was racially profiled by Ashley. Ashley has no business working with the public. She is a disgusting despicable person.

The staff was absolutely wonderful and kind and charming and sweet to my baby boy King Kong. But it's the Doctor the Vet herself that made me and my puppy feel uncomfortable. Even though he looks mean because he is a Strafford terrier, she got all Hannibal Lecter on my poor dog which scared my baby and ticked me off a little. She was so a scared to come close to him they put this cage on his face because she was afraid that he would do something to her. It was a traumatic experience for me and my puppy. I will never bring him back to her again. She should be ashamed for treating him that way and embarrassed. For God sakes she a Veterinarian. But the nurses are awesome. They loved him, it's her that's weird. I can't put him through that kind of treatment. He's to sweet of dog to traumatize him like that.It was my puppy's first time at the doctor's and they made him and us feel so uncomfortable and nervous. But the staff is awesome. Just beware of the kind of dog you bring in. You'll scare the doctor.
First time here.  Liked Dr. Morgan who took care of my dog.

I highly recommend Dr. June for her outstanding care of my cat, Lana. She has an excellent bedside manner—warm, patient, and truly attentive. Dr. June took ample time to explain Lana’s condition, offered several clear treatment options, and answered all my questions thoroughly without ever rushing.

Her responsiveness has also been exceptional, promptly returning messages and providing timely follow-up guidance. Dr. June combines clinical skill with genuine compassion, making her a trusted veterinarian. Thank you, Dr. June—we are very grateful.
The best vets in Chicago! Very efficient and timely appointments. The staff and vets made our kitties and us feel welcome and comfortable. Highly recommend!

I have been bringing my dog Jackson to UrbanPet Rx for years now. He is relatively healthy so I've mostly had to take him in for annual vaccinations and wellness exams.

I am writing this review now and giving them 5 stars due to the incredible professionalism that I recently experienced. There was an issue with his last appointment, and I reached out via email and explained the situation. I received a prompt response the next day with details of the corrective action(s) that had been taken and all of my concerns were addressed. Issues arise in business, but I will continue to come to this vet because of the excellent customer service even when there are problems.

I cannot recommend this place enough.
My poor 12-year-old kitty had an infection that cropped up because of a digestive problem. I couldn't get into my regular vet for a few days, but I could tell my cat was in terrible pain. Urban PetRx had an opening to see her right away, and I'm glad they did! They were able to diagnose and treat her very quickly. And when complications arose, Urban Pet saw what was happening and devised a plan to treat her unique problem. My kitty healed up perfectly and is back to her old self! They were very thorough and showed that they really cared through the whole ordeal. If I could give more stars, I would!

Urban PetRx was so GREAT to my pup Brodie. First time dog mom and they did an awesome job making us feel comfortable. They welcomed us in with big smiles first impressions are big and they were awesome!!! Gave us so much info and educated us  on our pup. DR. June and her team are hands down the best. I will always take my pup here for all his medical need. Thank you for having us♥️
Great vet and staff.

Dr. June LaFave and the entire Urban PetRx team are phenomenal. From the moment you walk in, you’re met with warmth, professionalism, and a genuine sense of partnership. As lifelong pet owners, we’ve seen our fair share of veterinary practices, but none compare to the level of care and compassion we’ve received here.
Add to all this Urban PetRx’s affordability and it’s clear: this is a rare gem in Chicago. If you’re looking for a veterinary care team that goes above and beyond, listens like a partner, and treats your pets like family, look no further.

Highly, highly recommend.

Beyond incredible, Dr. LaFave is absolutely amazing and takes such good care of our pets, even though they can be difficult at the vet. Prices are extremely reasonable and all the vet techs and front desk team members are also amazing to work with.
The doctor technicians and front desk attendants are all wonderful. We’re lucky to have them in Bridgeport.
Went in today for check up for my cat they were super friendly and explained everything well. Coming back to this place for future check ups!

Been  bringing my cats here for a couple years now!! brought my Gracie Rose in today with some concerns!! The staff is wonderful and makes you feel very comfortable and answers all your questions and needs ..would very much recommend this place!!
I didn't have to wait long for an appointment. Helpful staff, easy parking. Dr. Morgan was very attentive.
All workers there are super kind, and environment is always welcomed.

I highly recommend Urban PetRx and am happy to be able to bring our pets here. Consistently kind, considerate and helpful. They helped us handle our dogs cremation and we found their handling of it very gentle and compassionate. Thank you!
Highly recommend! It was a nice quiet clean office. Every employee I encountered during my visit was friendly helpful and knowledgeable. Very reasonably priced and left with prescriptions in hand.

We continue to be impressed by Dr. LaFaves approach at Veterinary Medicine. For context, animal families are going to have questions and concerns that extend beyond the actual visit- and she takes that into consideration. Thankfully, both Dr. LaFave and her office staff are extremely responsive to questions and concerns by phone and email. They continue to hear and validate concerns, taking into account the whole clinical picture. Highly recommend if you want a provider and care team that goes above and beyond for your family members.

I was looking forward to bringing my dog here & was looking for a new primary vet. While I very much appreciate that the staff clearly cares about animals I waited over 35 minutes in the exam room for a routine visit/core vaccines and eventually left because my dog was not being seen. It was an 11 AM appt, I arrived early, & made sure the paperwork was complete before arriving. If I’m expected to be on time & have the appropriate paperwork filled out before hand I also expect my time to be valued. I was told they were working on another animal in the back but if the business did not have time for my appointment and they shouldn’t have scheduled this appointment.
I love the team here. They take such amazing care of my pup and he even enjoys going.
Being from McKinley Park, I'm glad I can support this local spot. They were welcoming, and we're ready to answer my list of questions.

Dr. LaFave and ALL here are wonderful compassionate souls. Appointments and parking are easy, but most of all, the care received here is unparalleled. Thank you to all here for your wonderful minds and love in helping my little ones ❤️

Found this place through my works pet insurance. I looked at a couple places but this place had the best reviews and their social media was pretty active. They’re very helpful from the moment you call until the moment you’re leaving for the appointment. They’re also very transparent about their pricing and show you everything before anything is done. This will for sure be my fur baby’s vet for her entire existence god willing! Susie helped us out and she was soooo sweet. Dr. Morgan is so sweet and knowledgeable as well! Truly everyone there was sweet, personable and easy to work with.
Terrible spot been a customer before now they saying I'm a not existing customer SMH Urban you no Bueno I don't recommend this spot to anyone and way over priced too
Fabulous! My anxious and reactive rescue dog has received exceptional care here with no problems. Dr. June LaFave and the staff are wonderful. Thank you Urban PetRx!

The office staff, techs, and vets here are lovely and very helpful. We foster cats and have had more than a few tricky situations with them and our resident cat. They have been able to help us out every time
10/10 would recommend, a new vet in Bridgeport, staff was educated on pets, friendly and nice. Best of all my pet is healthy. Will be coming back
What a wonderful veterinarian ! The staff are so friendly. To me the most important thing about this place is by appointment only. I would rather pay extra for this convenience !
No place I need to bring my pet
Very nice vet and great staff
Excellent experience with Dr LaFave

Dr. Lafave is the greatest vet. She will care for your pet as if it was her own. She has the knowledge to keep your pet healthy. I have known Dr. Lafave for over a decade at her previous practice and this one and travel to continue seeing her because she is the best. She came highly recommended from her time leading the PAWS trauma unit years ago. When I have taken my dog in for emergency appointments at animal ERs the vets there knew Dr. Lafave. Lastly she is honest and won’t rip you off. She will tell you the situation with your pet and what if anything your pet needs. She is the Walter Payton of vets, true 🐐
Clean and petite. All staff, including Dr. LaFave were very nice and attentive. Slightly pricey to establish care but it’s close and convenient. Will be returning!
